entities.name: Maurice FitzGerald, Lord of Lanstephan

entities.summary: Maurice FitzGerald was Lord of Maynooth, Naas and Llanstephan. He was a medieval Anglo-Norman baron and a major figure in the Norman invasion of Ireland.
